verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Warp can launch AI-agent conversations over SSH (warp-docs-3) and run agents on remote machines without installing binaries (warp-docs-23), but nowhere does it describe the terminal itself propagating terminfo, shell integration scripts, or user config when SSHing into a remote host. In fact, community reports note friction with SSH sessions (e.g., code indexing/diff explorer breaking over SSH, warp-comm-10) rather than confirming seamless config/terminfo carry-over.
